# Open Duelyst enemy sprites

This project uses two animated unit sheets from the Open Duelyst art release:

- \`f4_nightsorrow.png\`
- \`f4_underworldbrute.png\`

Source: https://github.com/Jordyfel/duelyst-animated-sprites-godot

The repository republishes the Open Duelyst sprites and animation frame data under
CC0 1.0. The complete upstream license is kept in \`LICENSE.txt\`. The original sheets
remain unmodified; Unity import data, clips, and override controllers are generated by
\`EnemyVisualAssetBuilder\`.
